summary: AsiaStrategy (Nasdaq: SORA) filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, announcing plans to launch a digital asset pledging business for institutional and high-net-worth clients. The initiative would allow qualified counterparties to access USD liquidity using digital assets as collateral without selling holdings, with disciplined collateral management, defined loan-to-value parameters, and institutional custody. No specific deal terms, advisor, board recommendation, timing, or financial details were disclosed. The filing is a routine business update, not a special-situation event like an acquisition or restructuring.
